name: Mohar Varma
description: Mohar Varma is the old-fashioned head of the Varma family of Avishkar, a former consul of the Consulate and the father of Sita Varma.

bio.text: After his wife Madhu died in the New Phyrexian Invasion he raised Sita alone, holding to tradition and strict expectations for her.

timeline.summary: Jace knocks out Chandra and recovers Loot.
timeline.quote: he rendered her unconscious with an overwhelming mental attack, recovering Loot

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Travels with Loot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sita hides her racing suit and changes into the dress her father expects.
timeline.quote: She hides her racing suit in her nightstand and hurries to change into the dress he expects of her.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Mohar, who has not shed his consul's trappings, doles out strict expectations to Sita.
timeline.quote: Mohar Varma, Sita's father, has not yet shed the stations and signifiers of his former office

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Sita corrects her father that the plane is now called Avishkar and argues about tradition.
timeline.quote: It's Avishkar now

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Mohar hurls the radio across the room at the mention of Gonti.
timeline.quote: The moment Gonti's name is announced on the radio, Mohar hurls it across the room.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Mohar says Sita must be married advantageously, and then notices aether fumes on her.
timeline.quote: We must find you an advantageous marriage somewhere

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Sita arranges a cover story to leave her father's house for the race.
timeline.quote: If her father is to believe that she's needed elsewhere, he must see that she is needed elsewhere.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Lalan arrives and pretends Sita has an internship at her atelier.
timeline.quote: I just thought I'd swing by to pick up Sita for her internship.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Mohar approves the internship and embraces Sita.
timeline.quote: When you return, we'll stop by your mother's memorial and show her your creations.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Mohar sees the race footage on every channel and hears a howl in his halls.
timeline.quote: Every single channel is playing it on loop it seems.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: A green-skinned woman with tendril hair and a blue-cloaked man paralyze Mohar in his own home.
timeline.quote: it is a woman he sees—one with green skin and serpentine tendrils for hair.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: The intruders offer Mohar the power to undo the revolution and restore the old order.
timeline.quote: Would you like to make that dream a reality?

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Mohar toasts with Harshad to Kaladesh restored, backed by a cloaked mind-controller.
timeline.quote: Today, we toast to the glorious past of our nation, to Kaladesh restored.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: The cloaked man boasts he can force minds into any shape.
timeline.quote: It's as easy for me to force them into the shape I want as it is for you to breathe.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Harshad asks to see him crush people's will.
timeline.quote: I want to see you crush their will, as they have crushed my country.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Mohar says a powerful mind mage has agreed to help him.
timeline.quote: A powerful mind mage has agreed to lend us his assistance with

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Mohar asks his old friend Rudra, now in the barracks, to help restore Kaladesh by force.
timeline.quote: I need a force to put an end to the race.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Mohar says no revolution worth having has been bloodless, accepting a bloody trap at the finish line.
timeline.quote: No revolution worth having has ever been bloodless.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sita and her father are caught in traffic as the Invasion Tree crashes into Ishani's house.
timeline.quote: Twenty minutes later, they were only half a mile down the road, and Sita watched a limb of the Invasion Tree crash into Ishani's house.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Guards drag her before her father, who demands to know the meaning of this.
timeline.quote: Sita! Are you all right? What is the meaning of this? You could have been killed out there!

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Mohar orders his daughter taken to a doctor and tells his men to keep it secret.
timeline.quote: Tell no one of this.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Guarded by her father, Sita plans to use her last aether canister to cross the finish line.
timeline.quote: Most important of all, she still has one canister left.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Sita breaks free and disarms the guards to save Pia.
timeline.quote: Sita throws off the hands keeping her in place, rushes past her hapless father, and dives straight for Pia Nalaar.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Sita reveals her father Mohar is in jail for attempting a coup.
timeline.quote: Considering he's in jail, I think he has worse things to worry about

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Daretti backs Chandra as she fights insurgents in Mohar Varma's attempted Consulate coup, which is prevented.
timeline.quote: Ultimately, the coup was prevented, although the Rocketeers did not place in the race.

citation.text: "Daretti", section "Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Winter's and Spitfire's cars are totaled by safety measures activated by Mohar Varma.
timeline.quote: autonomous safety measures activated by Mohar Varma

citation.text: "Winter", section "2nd Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Madhu dies in the New Phyrexian Invasion, leaving Mohar to raise Sita alone.
timeline.quote: Madhu died in the New Phyrexian Invasion , leaving Mohar to raise his daughter alone.

citation.text: "Mohar Varma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On the first day of the second Ghirapur Grand Prix, Jace and Vraska break into Mohar's house offering to help him reinstall the Consulate.
timeline.quote: Jace Beleren and Vraska broke into his house, claiming that they wanted to help him overthrow the Avishkar Assembly and reinstall the Consulate.

citation.text: "Mohar Varma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mohar recruits Harshad and Rudra to trap the racers at the finish line and retake Kaladesh.
timeline.quote: The plan was to lay a trap for the racers at the finish line and retake Kaladesh while everybody was watching.

citation.text: "Mohar Varma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The trap stops the leading teams and reveals Sita as captain; the coup fails and Mohar is jailed.
timeline.quote: it failed, and Mohar was sent to jail.

citation.text: "Mohar Varma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A coup by her father stops Sita near the finish and reveals her identity.
timeline.quote: she was stopped by a sudden coup started by her father, which caused her identity to be revealed

citation.text: "Sita Varma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the race Sita becomes the city's fastest taxi driver, ignoring her incarcerated father.
timeline.quote: she became the city's fastest taxi driver

citation.text: "Sita Varma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Safety measures activated by Mohar Varma totaled Spitfire's and Winter's cars.
timeline.quote: Spitfire and Winter's cars were both totaled by autonomous safety measures

citation.text: "Speed Demons", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
